description: ATEBIM crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C90 H54 N14 Nd4 O32,4(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Nd1 (Nd) has 5 O neighbors; Nd2 (Nd) has 6 O neighbors; Nd3 (Nd) has 5 O neighbors; Nd4 (Nd) has 6 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 2 components; largest component is a chain with insufficient metal sites for a 3D shape classification. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 5.148-5.148 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 150.59-150.59°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula C90H58N14Nd4O36. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 2 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)), 4 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
